Inventory.title: Inventory
Inventory.subtitle: Tableware and table supplies: total count in the restaurant, how many belong on each table, reserve, breakage and losses.
Inventory.cardLowHint: Reserve below minimum or not enough for the tables
Inventory.stockExplain: "On tables" is how many should be on all active tables according to the norms (per-seat norm × seats + per-table norm × tables). "Reserve" = total − on tables.
Inventory.zeroStockHint: {count} items still have a quantity of 0. Enter the real counts via "Stock in" or "Stock count" — otherwise waiters can't report breakage or loss.
Inventory.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? If it has history, the item will be archived and kept in reports.
Inventory.starterAdded: {count} items added. Now enter the real quantity of each.
Inventory.emptyText: Add the list of items used in the restaurant. The starter list for a Chinese restaurant has 21 items (chopsticks, tea bowls, teapots, bowls…) with table norms — quantities start at 0, and each one can be edited later.
Inventory.emptyTextNoStarter: No active items. Add one with the "New item" button.
Inventory.emptyHint: Then enter the real quantity of each item via "Stock in" or count it in the "Stock count" tab.
Inventory.fNormHint: Table norm: how many belong on one table = per seat × seats + per table. E.g. tea bowl — 1 per seat, teapot — 1 per table. For items not placed on tables, set both to 0.
Inventory.fMinReserveHint: If the reserve (beyond what's on tables) drops below this, a "Running low" warning appears.
Inventory.fUnitPriceHint: Used to calculate the loss amount. Optional.
Inventory.fQuantityNewHint: Total in the restaurant: on tables and in reserve together. If you don't know, leave 0 and count it later in a stock count.
Inventory.fQuantityEditHint: Normally the quantity changes via "Stock in", "Broken" and "Stock count". If you change it here, a "Correction" is recorded in the history.
Inventory.fPurchasePriceHint: If entered, the item's price is updated too.
Inventory.lossDone: "{name}": loss of {qty} pcs recorded. Left on record: {left} pcs.
Inventory.fResponsibleHint: Who broke it or who is responsible — for records only.
Inventory.zeroStockLoss: 0 pcs on record — a manager must first enter the real quantity ("Stock in" or "Stock count").
Inventory.staffIntro: If a dish or table item gets broken, lost or becomes unusable, record it here. You will be listed as responsible.
Inventory.staffNoItems: The inventory hasn't been set up yet. Please contact a manager.
Inventory.staffStockHint: If it says "Not enough: only 0 pcs on record", a manager must enter the real quantities first.
Inventory.tablesExplain: The count on each table is calculated from the item norm: per-seat norm × seats + per-table norm. Change norms by editing the item in "Stock", and halls and tables in "Halls & tables".
Inventory.noTables: No active tables. First add a hall and tables in "Halls & tables".
Inventory.noNorms: No table norms set for items yet — the table sets are empty.
Inventory.noItemsForTables: The inventory is empty. First add items in "Stock".
Inventory.grandTotalsShortHint: Red border — the total on record isn't enough even for the tables.
Inventory.countIntro: Physically count all items — on tables and in reserve — and compare with the quantity on record (e.g. once a month). When completed, the recorded quantity is set to the counted one, and any shortage is counted as a loss.
Inventory.countExpectedHint: "Expected" is the current quantity on record (updated along with stock-ins and losses). Rows left empty count as not counted and stay unchanged.
Inventory.countCompleteHint: If counting takes a while, save it with "Save" and continue later.
Inventory.countCompleteConfirm:
Complete the stock count?

For the {counted} counted items (of {total}), the recorded quantity will be set to the counted one and the differences saved to history. Uncounted rows stay unchanged. This can't be undone.
Inventory.countCancelConfirm: Cancel the open stock count? Entered numbers will be discarded; recorded quantities won't change.
Inventory.countCompleted: Stock count completed: {adjusted} items adjusted. Shortage: {pieces} pcs ({sum}), surplus: {surplus} pcs.
Inventory.countNoDiff: No difference — everything is in place.
Inventory.errNotReady: Couldn't load inventory data. The database may not be updated yet — an administrator needs to run "prisma db push".
